question: The 23rd Commonwealth Games will be hosted by _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Australia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The 23rd Commonwealth Games will be hosted by **Australia**.
 
• It is scheduled to take place in **Victoria in 2026**.
 
• This marks the sixth time Australia will host the Commonwealth Games.
 
• The previous Commonwealth Games held in Australia were in **1938, 1962, 1982, 2006, and 2018**.
 
• Victoria 2026 will see events held across multiple cities and regional centers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Commonwealth Games**

 
 
• It is a multi-sport event involving athletes from the Commonwealth of Nations.
 
• The first Commonwealth Games were held in 1930 in Hamilton, Canada.
 
• It is held every four years and features athletes from over 50 countries.
 
• The Games include a wide range of sports such as athletics, swimming, cycling, and gymnastics.
 
• The Commonwealth Games Federation (CGF) is responsible for the direction and control of the Games.
 
 
 
• **Victoria 2026 Commonwealth Games**
 
 
• It will be the first time the Games are held in a decentralized format across multiple regional cities.
 
• Key locations include Geelong, Bendigo, Ballarat, and Gippsland.
 
• The Games are expected to feature 20 sports and 26 disciplines, including para-sports.
 
• This approach aims to promote regional development and showcase diverse parts of Victoria.
 
• Significant investments are being made in infrastructure and facilities to support the event.
 
 
 
• **Previous Commonwealth Games in Australia**
 
 
• Sydney 1938: The third edition of the Games was held in Sydney, featuring 15 nations.
 
• Perth 1962: Marked the first time the Games were held in Perth, Western Australia.
 
• Brisbane 1982: The Games saw significant international participation with 46 nations.
 
• Melbourne 2006: Featured 71 nations and introduced new sports to the Games.
 
• Gold Coast 2018: Hosted 71 nations and territories with a focus on inclusivity and sustainability.
